ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا ۗ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ
ayahs.translation_en: And to Thamud, We sent their brother Salih. He said, 'O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him.'

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ
ayahs.translation_en: And to Thamud, We sent their brother Salih. He said, 'O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him.'

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ
ayahs.translation_en: 'He is the One who created you from the earth and settled you therein. So ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him.'

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ جَاءَتْكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً
ayahs.translation_en: 'There has come to you a clear sign from your Lord. This is the she-camel of Allah, a sign for you.'

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.translation_en: 'So leave her to eat within the land of Allah and do not touch her with harm, lest a painful punishment seize you.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'This is a she-camel. For her is a time of drink, and for you is a time of drink on a specified day.'

ayahs.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
ayahs.translation_en: 'And inform them that the water is shared between them, each drinking is attended.'

ayahs.arabic: فَعَقَرُوا النَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا يَا صَالِحُ ائْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا
ayahs.translation_en: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, 'O Salih, bring us what you promise us.'

ayahs.arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ
ayahs.translation_en: But they hamstrung her. So he said, 'Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied.'
But they hamstrung her, and then became regretful.
But they called their companion, and he took a sword and hamstrung her.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home fallen prone.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: And the blast seized those who wronged, and they became within their homes fallen prone.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast, and they became like dry twigs of a fence-builder.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا
ayahs.translation_en: So when Our command came, We saved Salih and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us.
